page.title: Malaysia PDPA
page.description: Assess whether your organization must appoint a Data Protection Officer (DPO) and track appointment and commissioner notification records.
page.readOnly: You have read-only access to this Malaysia PDPA profile. An organization owner or administrator can update it.

status.title: DPO requirement status
status.description: This result is calculated by the server whenever the profile is saved.
status.thresholdNote: A DPO is required when personal data processing exceeds 20,000 data subjects, sensitive or financial data exceeds 10,000 data subjects, or activities involve regular and systematic monitoring.

reasons.personalDataVolume: Personal data processing exceeds 20,000 data subjects.
reasons.sensitiveDataVolume: Sensitive or financial data processing exceeds 10,000 data subjects.
reasons.regularMonitoring: Processing involves regular and systematic monitoring.

assessment.title: DPO requirement assessment
assessment.description: Enter the number of unique data subjects covered by the organization's processing activities.

totalDataSubjects.label: Total data subjects
totalDataSubjects.help: All individuals whose personal data is processed.

sensitiveDataSubjects.label: Sensitive or financial data subjects
sensitiveDataSubjects.help: Individuals whose sensitive personal data or financial information is processed.

regularMonitoring.label: Regular and systematic monitoring
regularMonitoring.help: Select this when the core processing activities regularly and systematically monitor data subjects.

appointment.title: DPO appointment
appointment.description: Record the organization profile appointed as DPO and the effective appointment time.

dpo.label: Appointed DPO
dpo.help: Only active organization profiles can be newly selected.

appointedAt.label: Appointed at
appointedAt.help: Required when a DPO profile is selected.

notification.title: Commissioner notification
notification.description: Track the notification that is due within 21 days after the DPO appointment.

notifiedAt.label: Notified at
notifiedAt.help: Leave blank until the notification has been submitted.

errors.update: Failed to update Malaysia PDPA profile

validation.totalDataSubjectsRequired: Enter the total number of data subjects.
validation.sensitiveDataSubjectsRequired: Enter the number of sensitive or financial data subjects.
validation.numberTooLarge: Enter a number within the supported safe range.
validation.sensitiveExceedsTotal: Sensitive or financial data subjects cannot exceed total data subjects.
validation.dpoAndAppointmentRequired: The DPO profile and appointment time must be provided together.
validation.notificationRequiresDPO: A commissioner notification requires an appointed DPO.
validation.notificationBeforeAppointment: The notification time cannot be earlier than the DPO appointment.
validation.referenceRequiresNotification: Enter a notification time before adding a reference.
validation.referenceTooLong: The notification reference must be 1,000 characters or fewer.
